name: Valerian Palace
scope: The surviving Valerian Palace ruins at Bishapur, limited to the photographed ashlared walls and nearby low masonry traces inside the mapped enclosure.
era: Standing and exposed ruins as photographed in March 2025.

stories.title: Valerian Palace: The Emperor's Gilded Cage

originalReview.notes: The exact site view shows a long thick side wall, open excavated passage, loose blocks and low adjacent rubble foundations.

originalReview.notes: The exact close view shows six to seven staggered courses of widely jointed, squared pale stone and partly displaced coping blocks.

review.method: Exact 2025 Qualla originals, independently mapped ruins envelope and field archaeology
review.notes: The two exact Qualla originals show the remains in 2025. The mapped polygon identifies this ruin separately from the neighboring Anahita Temple, Mosaic Porch and ceremonial buildings.
